sql_templates.description: Fetch upcoming or recent corporate events with results-related actions.
sql_templates.sql:
SELECT ce.symbol, ce.event_type, ce.event_date, ra.verdict, ra.score, ss.stage, ss.trading_signal, ce.source 
FROM signals.corporate_events AS ce 
JOIN scores.results_analysis AS ra ON ce.symbol = ra.symbol 
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots AS ss ON ce.symbol = ss.symbol 
WHERE ce.event_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) 
ORDER BY ce.event_date ASC 
LIMIT 100;
